title: Epic rollup
description: Every epic a record holds, with what it has delivered against what it promised. Derived on every call and stored nowhere, so a payload that disagrees with the record is stale rather than authoritative. It names no members: what serves one epic is the single-epic resolution's answer, described by epic.schema.json.

epics.description: One entry per document under epics/, in id order. An epic no entry has joined appears at zero rather than being omitted.

id.description: The title's slug plus four lowercase hexadecimal characters, shared across stories and epics so one id names one thing.

closed_points.description: Points delivered. `done` delivers; `cut` contributes nothing; `reshaped` delivers through its successor. One implementation computes this and the single-epic payload's identical field.

total_points.description: Points across every member, including a `cut` member — the total is what was promised.

open.description: Members not yet in closed.yml, a reopened member included.

closed_out.description: True when nothing remains open. Deliberately not a claim that the epic is done: an epic can close every member and still have delivered less than it promised, which the two point counts show and this field does not. Nothing derives a retirement decision from it, because no threshold a tool picks is one anybody agreed to.
